name: gizza-ai/xor-cipher
summary: XOR text, hex, or Base64 data against a repeating key; output hex, Base64, or UTF-8

tool.description: Repeating-key XOR cipher: XOR `data` against a repeating `key`, byte by byte. XOR is symmetric — the same operation encrypts and decrypts. Use it for CTFs, obfuscation, interop, and learning only; it is not secure encryption.

data.description: The data to XOR. Read as UTF-8 text by default, or decoded from hex/base64 when input=hex/base64.

input.description: How to read data: text, hex, or base64.

key.description: The non-empty repeating XOR key, read according to key_format.

key_format.description: How to read the key: text, hex, or base64.

output.description: How to encode the XOR result: hex, base64, or utf8.
